metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for managing spring-boot-properties-migrator dependency lifecycle during Spring Boot 3.0 upgrade. It differs semantically and operationally from peer candidates (banner migration, Redis property namespace update, HTTP header size config) which address specific property/file migrations. Existing skills are unrelated (Flink streaming operations). Candidate has clear support from Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide, no conflicts, and represents a unique tool-lifecycle capability not present in registry.
